description:
Recoverable Automated Ships
Gone are the days of wasteful [redacted] fights, missing out on obtaining ships.
For those who wish to recover [redacted] ships before being able to field them.
Version 1.0.0
Download
Changelogs
Source code
Dependencies: LunaLib (for LunaSettings)

What does this mod do?
This mod allows the recovery of automated ships without requiring the Automated Ships skill.
Recovery happens same as vanilla post-battle, however you can also recover derelict automated ships
which does have a LunaSetting to disable the feature in case of UI/dialog bugs.

NOTE: This does not allow you to field them in combat as well, for that you still need the skill.

Is it save-compatible?
In testing I've had no problem adding or removing the mod mid-save, but as always I suggest making a backup
of your save when adding mods mid-save.

Why was this made?
I've seen a multitude of people wonder why we cannot recover automated ships before being able to field them in combat.
They feel/felt like you should be able to recover them after fighting them in combat as to not lose out on obtaining any.
This feature is going to be added next Starsector version so this probably won't be update past it, but enough people
asked for this so thought why not make it for those who wish to have it right now.

AI use disclaimer
No AI was used in the creation of this mod's code or graphical assets

Credits
Fractal Softworks - The amazing team behind our beloved game Starsector
ZaHandoButAHunter - Came with the idea for this mod and helped with testing
